timing.zoneSearch.en: Search by UTC offset, IANA ID, or city
timing.zoneSearch.zh: 搜索 UTC 偏移、IANA 标识或城市

timing.intervalHint.hour.en: At least 1 hour. The interval counts from task creation or the last rule change and is independent of time zones.
timing.intervalHint.hour.zh: 至少 1 小时。间隔自任务创建或上次修改规则时起计，不受时区影响

timing.intervalHint.minute.en: At least 1 minute. The interval counts from task creation or the last rule change and is independent of time zones.
timing.intervalHint.minute.zh: 至少 1 分钟。间隔自任务创建或上次修改规则时起计，不受时区影响

timing.intervalHint.second.en: At least 60 seconds. The interval counts from task creation or the last rule change and is independent of time zones.
timing.intervalHint.second.zh: 至少 60 秒。间隔自任务创建或上次修改规则时起计，不受时区影响

timing.zoneNoStored.en: A one-time task stores only its target moment, not a time zone. The date and time are interpreted in the selected time zone.
timing.zoneNoStored.zh: 单次任务只保存触发时刻，不保存时区；日期和时间按所选时区换算

timing.inactive.en: Inactive tasks are read-only. Their timing cannot be edited.
timing.inactive.zh: 已结束的任务为只读，无法修改时间

timing.conflict.en: This task changed while you were editing. Your draft is retained. Cancel and reopen after refresh to edit the latest rule.
timing.conflict.zh: 编辑期间任务已变化，草稿已保留。请在刷新后取消并重新打开编辑器，以修改最新规则

timing.notFound.en: This task is no longer available. Your draft is retained; cancel to close the editor.
timing.notFound.zh: 此任务当前不可用，草稿已保留。请取消以关闭编辑器

timing.invalid.en: Enter a valid date and time, or check the timing fields.
timing.invalid.zh: 请输入有效的日期和时间，或检查时间字段

timing.invalidZone.en: Enter a valid IANA time zone, for example Asia/Shanghai.
timing.invalidZone.zh: 请输入有效的 IANA 时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai

timing.notFuture.en: Choose a date and time in the future.
timing.notFuture.zh: 请选择未来的日期和时间

timing.invalidInterval.en: Enter an interval of at least 1 minute.
timing.invalidInterval.zh: 请输入至少 1 分钟的间隔

timing.invalidInterval.hour.en: Enter an interval of at least 1 hour.
timing.invalidInterval.hour.zh: 请输入至少 1 小时的间隔

timing.invalidInterval.minute.en: Enter an interval of at least 1 minute.
timing.invalidInterval.minute.zh: 请输入至少 1 分钟的间隔

timing.invalidInterval.second.en: Enter an interval of at least 60 seconds.
timing.invalidInterval.second.zh: 请输入至少 60 秒的间隔
